verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a metered cloud browser and fetch/search API, so whether failed, blocked, or empty-result requests count against billing quota is a fair question for it. The evidence pack, however, has no documentation on billing rules, quota consumption, or how failed or blocked sessions are charged. The pack covers only sessions, agents, webhooks, SDKs and observability, none of which addresses billing for failed requests.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether failed, blocked, or empty-result requests still consume my billing quota
